entry_surfaces./: artist alley command centre — welcome greeting with active convention summary left, quick metric cards + live low-stock alerts panel right

entry_surfaces./productos: dense table/grid inventory with fast tactile -1 Vender button, quick-filter chips (tipo, fandom, stock status), search and batch actions
entry_surfaces./productos/nuevo: structured product creator with image upload/preview, fandom tagger, price and initial stock controls

routes_and_navigation.brand_header_rule: Displays custom logo if uploaded/configured; fallback to text store name with alt text matching store name. Displays active currency pill and quick session logout.

component_hierarchy.purpose: Welcome dashboard, total active stock, today's gross sales & quantity, urgent low-stock / sold-out priority feed, quick action shortcuts
Auth screen with preset notice for admin/1234, tokenless httpOnly / session management

Core artist alley inventory catalog. Includes dual view (Tactical List vs Visual Grid), instant '-1 Venta Rápida' with sound/visual feedback, instant filters (Fandoms: One Piece, Dragon Ball, Naruto, Genshin, Original, etc.; Tipos: Chapa, Print A4, Print A5, Sticker, Acrílico, Llavero; Estado: Sin Stock, Pocas Unidades, En Stock)
Product profile and stock controller (+ adding stock with optional cost, - selling or retiring damaged items), photo URL/file picker, price editing
Sales transactions of the day, total revenue, units sold per product, filter by calendar day, export CSV button
Configure backend logo vs text store name, default currency (€ EUR, $ USD, etc.), low-stock alert threshold (e.g. 3 units), custom fandoms manager, custom product types manager, password change
Step-by-step user and Netlify/cloud deployment guide with MongoDB configuration, convention best practices, and emergency offline backup tips

visual_enhancers.tactile_convention_mode: Large high-contrast buttons for rapid tapping behind the booth tablet without misclicks.
visual_enhancers.low_stock_visuals: Animated pulse warning icon + amber tint for items <= low_stock_threshold, red tint + strikethrough for 0 stock items.
visual_enhancers.quick_sale_toast: Immediate sonner toast on '-1 Venta' with an undo button (Revertir venta) to prevent mistake clicks in hectic convention crowds.

default_products.description: Anime art print illustration for gallery item
Artist alley booth in comic convention

motion.page_transitions: smooth opacity and slight y-axis slide (15px) for page routes

accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for fast tablet tapping on convention stands

instructions_to_main_agent: Language is Spanish ('es') throughout UI copy, buttons, error messages, and seed data.

Implement seed products with popular anime fandoms (Dragon Ball, One Piece, Naruto, Genshin Impact, Studio Ghibli, Spy x Family, Original) and merchandise types (Chapa / Pin metálico, Print A4, Print A5, Sticker vinilo, Stand acrílico, Llavero, Marcapáginas).
The default credentials must be admin / 1234 on login. Provide quick fill helper button for swift testing.
The product list must feature a very responsive quick '-1' (Vender 1) button with instant state update, toast notification with 'Deshacer', and automatic logging to the daily sales ledger.
Include high-visibility highlighting: products with 0 stock get a soft red border + badge 'Sin Stock'; products <= threshold get an amber badge 'Últimas X uds'.
In Settings: support editing Store Name vs Logo URL upload/preset, Currency choice (€, $, £, etc.), low stock alert threshold, customizable list of fandoms and product types (tags add/remove).

The Manual page must contain clear instructions on: 1) Using the app at convention stalls, 2) Daily sales reconciliation, 3) Backend + Netlify deployment guide with environment variables (MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, CORS_ORIGINS).
